attributes.name: Pygmy Ankylosaur
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, you may reduce all damage dealt to you by 1.

While displayed, when you do not defeat a non-villain monster you encounter and would shuffle it into the deck it came from, you may instead put it on top of that location deck or under that deck's top card. 

While displayed, you may put this card on top of your deck to reduce all damage dealt to you by 4, or to 0 if you have a role card.
